game.title: Kana Rush: a kana typing game
game.description: Pop kana bubbles by typing their romaji before they cross the field. Hiragana, katakana and kanji, four difficulties, challenge and endless modes.
game.lead: Type the reading in romaji. Each bubble pops when its full word or sentence is typed.
game.difficulty.easy.note: Easy: single kana, slow bubbles, 7 lives.
game.difficulty.normal.note: Normal: words of 2–4 kana, medium speed, 5 lives.
game.difficulty.hard.note: Hard: words with dakuten, combinations and small っ, fast, 3 lives.
game.difficulty.extreme.note: Extreme: short real sentences, 3 lives, and every 5 wrong keys cost a life.
game.saved: Progress is saved in this browser. No account required.

jlpt.title: JLPT simulation
jlpt.description: Free, timed JLPT mock exams for Kana, N5, N4 and N3 with the real structure, breaks between sections and a score report. Unofficial practice.
jlpt.lead: Same structure, timing and scoring scale as the real exam. Three sections in order, each with its own timer.
jlpt.rule.1: Skip and return to any question within a section using the question map.
jlpt.rule.2: Once a section is finalized you can't go back to it.
jlpt.rule.3: A 1-minute break follows each section (optional up to 15 minutes).
jlpt.rule.kana: Kana is a site-only level: pass with 60% overall and at least 40% in each section.
jlpt.testAudio.phrase: これは　おとの　テストです。きこえますか。
jlpt.testAudio.none: This browser has no Japanese voice, so listening questions can't be played here. Try another browser or device.
jlpt.start.emailHint: It stays in this browser. We only use it if you ask us to send your result link.
jlpt.start.public: Show my nickname and level in “recent runs”.
jlpt.start.soon: The {level} question bank is being written. Coming soon.
jlpt.start.noscript: The simulation needs JavaScript to keep time and send your answers.
jlpt.start.mobile: You can take the test on a phone, but a computer is recommended.
jlpt.start.error.limit: Too many simulations were started from this network. Try again in an hour.
jlpt.start.error.unavailable: The simulation is not available right now. Please try again later.
jlpt.start.error.generic: The simulation could not start. Check your connection and try again.
jlpt.resume.text: You have a {level} simulation in progress. Its timer keeps running.
jlpt.tips.title: Before you start
jlpt.tips.1.title: Resist the restart
jlpt.tips.1.text: A bad first question is normal. Keep going: a full run tells you more than a perfect start.
jlpt.tips.2.title: Don't get stuck
jlpt.tips.2.text: If a question takes too long, pick your best guess, flag it with F and come back at the end.
jlpt.tips.3.title: Manage your energy
jlpt.tips.3.text: Use the breaks. Stand up, drink some water and look away from the screen.
jlpt.tips.4.title: Mistakes are valuable
jlpt.tips.4.text: Every wrong answer comes with an explanation at the end. That review is where you learn most.
jlpt.disclaimer: Unofficial practice simulation. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or a substitute for the Japanese-Language Proficiency Test administered by the Japan Foundation and JEES.
